Implemented the upgrade and production fix.

Changed:
- [pom.xml](/app/pom.xml:403): bumped `google-api-client-bom` to `1.31.4`.
- [ApiClientUtils.java](/app/src/main/java/com/google/firebase/internal/ApiClientUtils.java:83): added centralized default JSON/transport helpers, forcing `JacksonFactory`.
- Routed production callers in `FirebaseApp`, `FirebaseOptions`, and `Template` through `ApiClientUtils` instead of direct API client `Utils`.

Verification:
- `mvn -DskipTests package` passes.
- `mvn test -DskipITs` compiles but fails in existing unmodified tests that still assume old JSON factory behavior, plus local ADC/env-dependent failures. I did not modify test files per constraint.
